utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what’s the repair drive focus this time?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly home fixes—leaky faucets, broken outlets, that sort of thing. I heard they’re trying to help folks get the basics working again.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—are they taking sign-ups now, or is there a waitlist?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hand and a few tools for the repair drive—just tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus—uh, I might need a hammer and maybe some tape. I’m a little behind, so just point me to where I should start.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—I’ve got a hammer and tape you can use. Start by checking the loose boards, and I’ll point you to the next spot after that.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a nice turnout so far—people have been pretty generous. I’ll let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s good to hear—I'll just keep an eye on the timing and where things are getting dropped off. Logistics always get messy if we don’t stay on top of them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good call—I’ll keep an ear out for any timing updates or drop-off changes and pass them along. Hopefully it stays nice and orderly for once!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you help by checking which homes on Maple and Cedar still need pickup, then drop the list by my porch before noon?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check Maple and Cedar and leave the list on your porch before noon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’ve been telling folks all afternoon—if you’re free, come by and bring a friend.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can probably stop by for a little while. Thanks for letting me know, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Uli — even a quick stop would be great. I’ll be around if you want the details when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll help keep the repair drive organized, and we can make a simple plan together.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — let’s keep it simple: a list of repairs, who’s doing what, and a quick check-in time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good — I’ll jot down the repairs, assign each one, and set a quick check-in time so we can stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs fixing for the repair drive? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’m a bit behind, but I think it’s mainly the loose porch step and the flickering hallway light. I can double-check and let you know if anything else got added.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. Please double-check and send me the full list when you can, and I’ll go from there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule, but I’ll need the details for the repair drive first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — I’ll send over the repair drive details and work around the school schedule. Really appreciate your help coordinating.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, send them when you can and I’ll take a look. I’ll work it around the school schedule once I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon—do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think they’re still looking for volunteers, tools, and a few extra hands for setup. I can ask around and let you know what turns up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules — I’d really appreciate that. I can help with setup if they still need people.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I can help, just point me to what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, can you confirm you’re free for the repair drive this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m free this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m in—what kind of repairs are we focusing on for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Mostly the little stuff folks keep putting off—leaky faucets, loose steps, squeaky doors, that sort of thing. I’m trying to keep it simple so more neighbors can jump in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense—small fixes can make a big difference. I can help with the list and see who needs what.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help with that—I'll keep the repair drive plan moving and let folks know what’s next.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on supplies and make sure we’ve got what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great — I’ll follow up with the next steps and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I meant to bring something by, but I keep forgetting the list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I know how that goes — I can remind you of the list if you want. I’ll swing by the repair drive later too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d help a lot, thanks. If you remind me later, I should finally make it over there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed the details, but I’m in if you need help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great—thanks, Noah. I’ll send the details and what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Leo—send them my way when you can, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — I can lend a hand if you need any tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s keep it simple: I’ll bring the list, and you can tell me which tools you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — bring the list by, and I’ll mark what I’ve got ready to lend.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Quinn—what’s the first thing you need me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara! Could you start by checking who’s available this Saturday and jotting down anyone with tools or a truck?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll check who’s available this Saturday and note anyone who has tools or a truck.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive—do you want me to tell both groups, or just the folks who usually show up first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Tell both groups, please—I'd like everyone to hear about it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll let both groups know. I’ll keep it simple and make sure everyone hears the details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad you asked, Cleo — I’ve started organizing the repair drive and I’m pulling together the list of needed supplies now. If you’d like, I can also share how you can help or where we’re meeting.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — please send me the supply list and the meeting spot. I’ll keep track of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send you the supply list and meeting spot right away. Thanks for helping keep track; that’ll make this a lot smoother.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive happening soon—do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don’t know yet—what items are they still short on?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure either—I just caught it second-hand. I can ask around and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what’s the repair drive for, and when’s it happening?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s for collecting tools and supplies to help fix up the old community center, and it’s this Saturday morning at the school lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll swing by Saturday morning at the school lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what kind of help you mean for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with hands-on repairs, carrying supplies, or organizing volunteers — whatever you need most.
